title: LearnOps course package (B1, v1)
description: The parsed content of course.yaml in a course package (PRD B1.1). Markdown bodies and assets sit beside it and are not described here. This schema checks structure only; rules that need a view of the whole course (PRD B1.2, B1.3, B1.4) are listed under $comment and are enforced by validator code, not by this file.
$comment: Unknown fields are allowed on purpose: after Release 0 contracts change only by adding optional fields and readers ignore unknown fields (PRD B.0, EXT-02). NOT expressible in JSON Schema, so NOT enforced here: B1.2 rule 1 (exactly one guide Page and one task Assignment per week), rule 2 (week N unlocks when the week N-1 task is submitted; unlock.after must name an earlier activity), rule 3 (graded points sum to total_points), rule 5 (completion tracking on for every activity used in an unlock rule), rule 6 (idnumbers unique within the course and never reused); B1.3 (marking table inside the assignment body: markers, columns, points sum, allowed Check values); B1.4 (protected idnumbers other than the two defaults, and section numbers that collide with the configurable protected_section); B7 (that the .h5p file named by an h5p activity exists, and that an ordinary optional practice entry comes right after the week's guide Page: the list order is the order, there is no ordering field; where a video checkpoint goes is decided in B7 section 4). start_date is checked for calendar validity only when the validator is run with a format checker; the pattern guarantees the YYYY-MM-DD shape either way.

identifier.description: Lowercase ASCII letters and digits separated by single hyphens (PRD B1.1 slug, B1.2 rule 6 idnumber). The end anchor is (?![\s\S]) instead of $ because Python's $ also matches before a trailing newline.

allOf.description: Default protected idnumbers (PRD B1.4). They are owned by the course template and must never appear in a package, in either mode. Extra protected idnumbers a site configures are checked by validator code.

relative_path.description: A relative path inside the package folder, with forward slashes (PRD B1.1, C-08). It is the same rule as the B6.3 relative_path in contracts/lesson-manifest.v1.schema.json: the pattern below is a copy of that pattern, not a second list, and a test checks that the two are equal. Non-empty; forward slashes only; no whitespace; no ?, #, % or backslash; no URL scheme or drive letter (nothing like https: or C: at the start); not absolute; no empty, '.' or '..' segment; no control or format character (guide decision): the complete Unicode 15.0.0 categories Cc (U+0000-U+001F, U+007F-U+009F) and Cf (U+00AD, U+0600-U+0605, U+061C, U+06DD, U+070F, U+0890-U+0891, U+08E2, U+180E, U+200B-U+200F, U+202A-U+202E, U+2060-U+2064, U+2066-U+206F, U+FEFF, U+FFF9-U+FFFB, U+110BD, U+110CD, U+13430-U+1343F, U+1BCA0-U+1BCA3, U+1D173-U+1D17A, U+E0001, U+E0020-U+E007F), from the Unicode Character Database 15.0.0 DerivedGeneralCategory.txt. Private-use, surrogate and unassigned code points are not rejected as categories. No percent sign (%) anywhere (guide decision): with the lab 'none' signer (B6.4) the relative path is appended to the media base URL, and layers that decode a path, once or more, could turn an encoded form (%2e, %2F, %5c, %252e, %25%32%65 and so on) into a dot or separator; rejecting % rejects every such form. The path is never decoded or normalized. Considered but not enforced in v1 (guide decision): Windows reserved names (such as CON, NUL, COM1) and Unicode normalization, because the store is on Linux or S3 and no consumer compares names, so these rules would protect nothing; if a store later needs them, that is a v2 discussion. No maximum path length is specified in v1 (guide decision): paths are built from bounded slugs and the store enforces its own limits, so any number chosen now would be invented. The list is pinned to Unicode 15.0.0; a newer Unicode version is a contract change, not an automatic one. libs/media_paths must use the same Unicode 15.0.0 Cc and Cf range tables (CC_RANGES and CF_RANGES). The pattern lists code points outside the BMP as the characters themselves (JSON surrogate-pair escapes), because Python's \U escape and ECMA-262's \u{...} escape each work in only one of the two; ECMA-262 validators must therefore compile patterns with the u (Unicode) flag, as Draft 2020-12 validators such as Ajv do by default. Shared valid and invalid cases: contracts/test-vectors/relative-path.v1.json.

allOf.description: Ends in a lowercase .h5p after a non-empty file name.

h5p_file.description: Path of the practice item's .h5p file inside the package folder (PRD B7). The same rules as body (relative_path: not a URL, not absolute, no '..' segment, no backslash) and it must end in lowercase .h5p. Only the shape is checked: the schema does not look for the file, and no real .h5p file is kept in the repository.

shortname.description: Stable; matches the Moodle course shortname.

slug.description: Immutable; media paths use it (PRD B1.1).

total_points.description: Graded points across the course sum to this (PRD B1.2 rule 3; default 100).

mode.description: full generates a whole course; sections-only generates only the listed week sections for merging into a template course (PRD B1.4).

idnumber.description: Optional authoring label (PRD B1.1, B1.2 rule 6). Moodle stores no idnumber for a section, so a section is matched by its number. Absent is valid; a present value must be a valid idnumber (null and an empty string are errors) and is unique within the package.

after.description: idnumber of the activity that must be complete (submitted) first; null for the first week.

start_date.description: Optional ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Keep it quoted in YAML so it stays a string.

body.description: Markdown file for the activity. For an assignment it must contain a marking table (PRD B1.3).

completion.description: submit: the activity is complete when the learner submits (PRD B1.2 rule 2).

then.description: H5P practice is never graded and names its .h5p file (PRD B7; guide's decision on Issue #44, question 2). file is defined for h5p only: on any other type it is an unknown field and is not checked.
